history.subject: Cech-Picard dictionary: Picard class of a unit cocycle along a finite basic refinement, sorry-free. BasicRefinement structure (finite pointed basic subcover; existence from exists_basicOpen_le + quasi-compactness; product merge), coverCocycle (restricted evInf evaluations), isCoverCocycle (diagonal normalization via unitsRestrict_unitsEvInf_self, cocycle identity via restricted unitsEvInf_trans; canonical localization maps = presheaf restrictions by algHom uniqueness), faithfully flat cover algebra via span criterion, and BasicRefinement.pic into CommRing.Pic of the global sections. Picard/PicAffineCover.lean

Cech-Picard dictionary assembled end-to-end: toPic homomorphism statement tree elaborates. LocalizationCocycle.lean: cover cocycles as descent cocycles (piDouble/piTripleEquiv, cocycleUnit; picClass coboundary/refinement invariance wrappers proved modulo 8 pi-ext transport leaves); PicAffine.lean: the three comparison moves (restriction, cohomologous twist, merge of refinements), master pic_congr PROVED from the moves, toPic MonoidHom + toPic_injective assembled (11 leaves open). Both files elaborate; leaves are mechanical idempotent-evaluation and unitsRestrict-calculus goals.

Cech-Picard dictionary: toPic quotient glue proved. pic_ofLE (restriction move, on-the-nose coverCocycle agreement), pic_one, pic_mul, toPicFun well-definedness and computation rule, MonoidHom map_one/map_mul; remaining leaves: cohomologous twist, merge comparisons, triviality extraction. Picard/PicAffine.lean

Cech-Picard dictionary: cohomologous invariance (Move 2) proved. pic_eq_of_isCohomologous via the abstract coboundary invariance of the descent Picard class; comparison units restricted through the basic refinement, canonical overlap maps identified with restriction by localization-algHom uniqueness; pic_eq_picClass definitional interface added to PicAffineCover.

Cech-Picard dictionary: refine-comparisons (Move 3a/3b) proved. pic_interFst/pic_inter along fst/snd projections via abstract refinement invariance picClass_map_refine; unit conditions from divisibility, refinement overlap maps identified with restrictions; basicOpen_le_of_dvd helper.

Cech-Picard dictionary: merge bridge (Move 3c) proved — pic_eq_pic complete. pic_interFst_eq_inter: the two point-selections on the merged refinement differ by the index-wise coboundary of cross evaluations gamma(P.pt, Q.pt); two unitsEvInf_trans applications on the double overlap; interFst redefined by point-update of inter so the merges share index/section data definitionally. All three comparison moves now proved; pic_congr and toPic MonoidHom fully assembled.

Cech-Picard dictionary: injective descent homomorphism COMPLETE at the scheme level. class_eq_one_of_pic_eq_one: trivial descent class makes the descent unit a coboundary, whose per-index units glue back through the family coboundary lemma to trivialize the H1 class; toPic_injective closed. Picard/PicAffine.lean is sorry-free; the only remaining leaves of the dictionary are the eight pi-ext transport lemmas in Algebra/LocalizationCocycle.lean.

Cech-Picard dictionary: the eight pi-ext transport lemmas closed — dictionary homomorphism direction fully landed, axiom-clean. Simplicial ring maps (lmul', three faces, two inclusions, refinement map) computed through the pi-double/triple identifications by evaluating A-algebra maps on coordinate idempotents; coboundary extraction and construction; full build green 8604 jobs; toPic and toPic_injective depend only on propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound.

Charter hygiene: split the three oversized dictionary files under the 500-line cap. UnitDescent -> UnitDescent + UnitDescentMap (base change section); LocalizationCocycle -> base + LocalizationCocycleRefine (coboundary detection, picClass wrappers, cover refinement); PicAffine -> comparison moves + CechPicToPic (the toPic homomorphism and injectivity); aggregator updated; full build green 8607 jobs; axiom audit re-confirmed post-split (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound).
